Body.Content:
Today, we released a patch version of the Azure App Service Mobile Apps .NET SDK. If you have already adjusted your clients to use version 3.0.1, then this update does not provide any benefit. However, if you are upgrading from version 2.x to get support for Android Nougat, you should use version 3.0.2.

Read the full details about this release in our team blog.
